title: console Flow Runs page: its flow list reads a `spec`-wrapped item shape no server serves, and its test fixtures feed only that shape (the shape that hid objectui#12783)
body:
Filing gate ①: a consumer-side tolerance arm with no measured producer, and test fixtures in a shape the server does not serve. **reach:** none user-visible today. The cost is test blindness: every suite on this page feeds `spec`-wrapped items, so a read that only works on that shape stays green, as the label read in objectui#12783 did until a browser run caught it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from the open question in the os-dev report on objectui#12783 (PR #12828). That PR keeps the arm, as its claim pinned. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The landing is `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx` (the `loadFlows` normalization) and the page's test fixtures.

## Measured (objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-showcase`, from the objectui#12783 run)
- `GET /api/v1/meta/flow`, the answer the page receives, is the `{type, items, registrations}` envelope with 32 items. 0 of them carry a `spec` member; all 32 carry `name` and `label` on the item itself.
- The spec's `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema` types `items` as `unknown`, so no declared shape asks for `spec`.

## Read from source (PR #12828's head `d841908`)
- The normalization reads `name` and `label` as `it?.spec?.X ?? it?.X`, and `spec: it?.spec ?? it`. The `spec` arm is the one no server is measured to feed.
- The fixtures that feed `spec`-wrapped items:
  - `FlowRunsPage.test.tsx`;
  - `FlowRunsPage.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`;
  - `developerMetadataEnvelope.contractEnvelope-6917.test.tsx`;
  - case 2 of PR #12828's new pin.
- The same normalization also reads `updatedAt ?? updated_at` into a field the page never renders.

## Expected
- First a census of every server of `meta.getItems('flow')` the console talks to: the objectstack runtime, the `?preview=draft` path, the cloud runtime, and any MSW or fixture server. If none serves `spec`-wrapped items, the page reads the served flat item only, and its fixtures move to the served shape. An unread arm and its fixtures are retired at once, not staged.
- If a producer of the wrapped shape is found, the card records it and the arm stays, with a fixture in each shape.

**Dedupe** (open and closed):
- every objectui `domain:ui` card (2433 rows, through #12743) plus the newest objectui issues (#12732–#12821), grepped for `spec-wrapped|spec arm|spec?.name|spec?.label`, `flattened meta item`, `getItems('flow')` and `readFlattenedMetaItems`: 0 hits beyond objectui#12783 itself;
- `FlowRunsPage` hits objectui#12553 (the page header, closed) and #6917 (non-`QueryResult` count arms, closed), both other subjects.

Dedupe words: FlowRunsPage spec arm, spec-wrapped meta item fixture, flattened getItems flow fixture shape, consumer tolerance no producer.
